19 ORDER
20 On May 16, 2023, the Board issued an order resolving the record
21 objections, settling the record, and establishing the briefing schedule. On that
22 date, the record was comprised of a record and a supplemental record. On July
23 27, 2023, LUBA received from the county a Second Supplemental Record that
24 was intended to contain an audio recording of the board of county
25 commissioners’ October 19, 2022, meeting. However, that Second Supplemental
26 Record did not contain an audio recording of the October 19, 2022, meeting.
27 Petitioners filed their petition for review on July 10, 2023. Pursuant to the
28 parties’ stipulated briefing schedule, the deadline for filing the respondent’s and
29 intervenor-respondent’s briefs is August 21, 2023.
Page 2
On August 7, 2023, the Board received petitioners’ 1 Motion to Supplement
2 the Record (Motion) with the audio recording of the board of county
3 commissioners’ October 19, 2022, meeting that the county mistakenly excluded
4 from the Second Supplemental Record transmitted to petitioners (Third
5 Supplemental Record).
6 The Motion is granted. All deadlines in the appeal remain unchanged,
7 including the deadline for filing the respondent’s and intervenor-respondent’s
8 briefs.1 Oral argument previously scheduled for September 12, 2023, at 11:30
9 a.m. remains unchanged.
10 Dated this 9th day of August 2023.
